name: @aise/adapter-contract
description: AISE shared client adapter contract (PROD-016, SHARED): versioned platform-neutral semantic objects (ProjectContext, TaskIntent, CapabilityDescriptor, EvidenceSummary, RealitySummary, BOQContext, EngineeringCaseSummary, InterventionScenarioSummary, OutcomeSummary, NextBestAction, AuthorizationContext, OperationResult), client capability negotiation and the adapter conformance harness for the browser/mobile/desktop adapters over one AISE product core (ACR-004). Data + contract logic only — no I/O in the harness core, no server behavior, no UI, no client-side authority. POST-005 adds the additive ./task-handoff subpath: the cross-device field task identity envelope (FieldTaskHandoff) and the canonical aise://task deep-link codec.
